CA.rationale: Content entries with matching origin/process metadata explicitly link content and processing (command_estimate).

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue) entries, explicit organization (candidate node), and distinct origin/status fields are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing/estimation kinds (command_estimate, history_estimate, inherited_current) explicitly link processing/origin to the same content nodes.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content assignments (color labels bound to coordinate sets) are present.

D.rationale: The report separates identified content (color/locations) from explicit status/origin metadata for the same referent.

O.rationale: Content is presented within an explicit candidate/node organization with origin markers indicating how it emerges/is represented.
